limitations: Exposed trace lengths omit inside-pad distance, component internal paths and vertical barrel length; do not treat these numbers as complete propagation delays.
MCU matrix, U801/U804 propagation and load/duty effects are not modeled or bench-qualified. Full timing must be checked at receiving pins at initial48kHz/32-bit stereo3.072MHz BCLK.
GND via/PTH proximity is read from actual copper source. Actual contact to both inner GND planes must also pass repour/DRC and CAM.
Native engine DRC and final CAM remain authoritative separate checks; unparsed POURED cache is not credited by this source geometry audit.
